title: service-automation: resuming a run paused at a `map` node by the PARENT run id completes the parent and leaves the parked item child suspended — accepted shape or a skipped item?
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① a behaviour measured beside a ruled card, by the #27743 dev (PR #27872, os-dev-report 6513464095, out-of-scope finding 2). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade, including whether this is the accepted shape.

## Measured (engine.resume, on PR #27872's head)

A run paused at a `map` node (correlation `map:CHILD`), resumed at the **parent** run id with an item child whose node has `resumeAuthority: any`: the resume answers success, the parent is recorded `completed`, and the item child stays suspended (`listSuspendedRuns` still holds it). The map advanced past the parked item without running it.

## Why it may be intended

The `LINKED_RUN_PREFIXES` docblock in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` names this advance as the reason the resume gate reads the child, so for open authority it may be the accepted shape. If so, the orphaned child suspension is still left behind.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

Either rule it the accepted shape (and decide what happens to the orphaned child suspension), or make a parent-id resume of a map either refuse or resume the parked item. ⚠️ `engine.ts` is on the hot-file queue (#25522, the engine.ts split, in flight).

## Dedupe

Read the open `domain:server` titles for `map` + `resume`, `suspended`, `parked item`: none. **New.**

Links back: #27743, PR #27872
